title: Mario Eisouoku ~ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer - A Paradise of Leaves Above
description:
The title screen (and overworld) theme from マリオ永草億　～ Illusionary Blossom of Cranium Prayer.

A peaceful song with the Theme of Eastern Story motif in it, true to Touhou form. This song makes me think of autumn.
